definitions.mbe_other: retrieved 'mbe' record that is not the question's own annotated passage (gold_idx)
definitions.other_eval: mbe_other that is the annotated passage of another evaluated question
definitions.same_group: other_eval whose question is in the same fact-pattern group (npz mbe_groups, 844 groups)
definitions.validation: mbe_other whose text matches (token Jaccard >= 0.9) the gold_passage of one of the 124 omitted validation questions (their gold ids are absent from the evaluated corpus)
definitions.unannotated_mbe: mbe_other annotated for no released question (evaluated or validation)
definitions.qsim: max token Jaccard (lowercase [a-z0-9]+ sets) of prompt+question between the question and the question(s) the retrieved passage is annotated for
definitions.same_prompt: that other question has an identical, non-empty (case/whitespace-normalised) fact pattern (675 of 1,071 evaluated questions have an empty prompt field)
definitions.text_copy: token Jaccard between the retrieved passage text and the question's own annotated passage text >= 0.5
definitions.pct_lists_with_X: share of lists with at least one such passage
